blocks.text: You can use and manage dedicated proxy ports in the Zscaler Admin Console. To learn more about dedicated proxy ports for Internet & SaaS, see Configuring Dedicated Proxy Ports.

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Infrastructure > Client Connector > Dedicated Proxy Port.
Select an available port from the Select Dedicated Proxy Port drop-down menu. Zscaler Client Connector attempts connections with this port before using the following ports in this order: 443 or 80.
